text:
Acronis Bundle — Unified Backup & Recovery Suite for Windows 10 & 11

 

 📦 PowerShell Install Button

 

 

 

---

The Acronis Bundle delivers a self-contained desktop deployment package for Windows x64 environments, purpose-built for offline provisioning and local testing scenarios. This build integrates the Acronis toolset into a single, eliminating dependency resolution and enabling deterministic rollout across managed endpoints. Engineered for administrators who require reproducible installation behavior, the bundle supports unattended execution and streamlined configuration across workstation fleets. Its architecture ensures consistent component versions and reduces operational overhead during large-scale desktop deployments.

 🔧 Requirements

- OS: Windows 10 / 11
- Shell: PowerShell 5.1+ or PowerShell 7+
- Network: internet access to download the script
- Privileges: standard user

 Features

 Unified Deployment: Delivers the Acronis application suite as a single self-contained desktop package, eliminating dependency resolution and network-bound installation steps during rollout.

- Pre-Configured Runtime Environment: Ships with all required runtimes and libraries bundled, ensuring deterministic behavior across target workstations without supplementary framework.

- Offline-Capable Provisioning: Supports fully disconnected deployment scenarios, enabling installation and activation on isolated machines or restricted network segments.

- Silent and Unattended Execution: Provides command-line parameters for non-interactive installation, allowing integration with existing software distribution pipelines and endpoint management tooling.

- Local License Provisioning: Includes an embedded activation mechanism that finalizes licensing locally during, removing the need for online validation round-trips at deployment time.

- Configuration Profile Import/Export: Enables administrators capture a tuned configuration from a reference workstation and apply it consistently across an entire fleet.

- Modular Component Selection: Allows granular choice of which bundled modules are installed, so deployments can be scoped the exact feature set required per workstation tier.

- Rollback and Repair Support: Includes built-in repair and clean-uninstall routines that restore the system a pre-deployment state without leaving residual registry entries or orphaned services.

- Integrity Verification: Validates package contents against an embedded manifest before execution, detecting corruption introduced during transfer or storage.

- Diagnostic Logging: Emits detailed, timestamped logs for every installation phase, simplifying troubleshooting and audit trails in managed environments.

- Version Pinning: Preserves a fixed build identifier so that deployments remain reproducible and comparable across machines and time periods.

 How It Works

Acronis Bundle operates as a self-contained desktop that provisions the Acronis application suite without requiring an active internet connection during. The bundle packages all core binaries, runtime dependencies, and configuration assets into a single distributable, ensuring consistent deployment behavior across target machines.

The installation engine performs a staged extraction of embedded components, verifies integrity against signed manifests, and registers the required services and drivers through the Windows subsystem. Component selection is resolved automatically based on detected system architecture and existing software state, minimizing manual configuration during rollout.

Deployment proceeds through a layered pipeline: environment validation, prerequisite resolution, payload extraction, service registration, and post-install verification. Each stage logs its status a local journal, allowing operators audit the installation path and confirm that all modules initialized correctly.

The bundle supports silent and attended installation modes, enabling integration into automated provisioning workflows or manual desktop. Configuration parameters can be supplied through a local response file, allowing administrators tailor feature selection, installation paths, and update behavior match organizational standards.

Post-installation, the application entirely from local resources, with no dependency on external servers for core functionality. Built-in verification routines confirm that services are responsive and that the installed components match the expected manifest before the process reports completion.

 Compatibility

Acronis Bundle is validated against the following desktop environments and deployment scenarios.

 Operating System Support 
- Windows 10 (21H2 and later), Windows 11 (22H2 and later), Windows Server /
- Both x64 and ARM64 architectures are supported on compatible Windows builds
- Legacy BIOS and UEFI boot modes are handled transparently by the

 Runtime Requirements 
-.NET Desktop Runtime 6.0 or newer (bundled dependency resolution included)
- Minimum 4 GB RAM; 8 GB recommended for concurrent imaging operations
- 2 GB available disk space for installation, plus space for backup targets

 Disk and File System Compatibility 
- NTFS, ReFS, FAT32, and exFAT volumes are recognized for source and destination operations
- GPT and MBR partition tables are supported for disk imaging
- Dynamic disks and Storage Spaces configurations are detected and handled through native Windows APIs

 Virtualization and Cloud Environments 
- Compatible with Hyper-V, VMware Workstation, and VirtualBox guest sessions
- Works within standard VDI templates without additional guest agents
- Supports backup targets on local, network-attached, and removable media

 Integration Notes 
- Coexists with standard Windows Defender and third-party endpoint protection when exclusions are configured for the installation directory
- Command-line automation is available through the bundled CLI component for scripted deployment workflows
- Silent installation flags are documented
